text:
[IRET.10.2] **Logical emit.** Same as plain emit but
registers the asserted fact's ID in the TMS dependency
table under the current activation's ID.

idris.name: iret_10_2__record
idris.note: A logical emit registers the asserted fact's id under the current activation; an explicit emit registers nothing.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__do_action_tms_agree
idris.note: A logical emit registers the same row on both sides: the record reads the working memory and the lifecycle, which agree.

idris.name: iret_10_2__record_elem
idris.note: A row of the table after a record is an old row or the recorded one, whose target is a live fact of the emitted kind.
